chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn al-Ash'ari, from Ibrahim ibn Hamawayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqteeni, who said: Al-Rida (peace be upon him) said regarding
the white cock: it has five traits from the traits of the Prophets: its knowledge of the times of prayer, zeal, generosity, courage, and frequent mating.

key_terms.الْغَيْرَةُ: zeal or jealousy (in a positive sense)

ai.seo_question: What are the five prophetic traits found in a white cock according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) draws a symbolic parallel between the natural virtues of the white cock and the spiritual qualities of the Prophets, highlighting their role as divinely appointed timekeepers of worship. This comparison underscores the Islamic emphasis on *ghayrah* (zeal/protectiveness) and *shaja'ah* (courage) as essential traits for spiritual leadership, while also reflecting the biological reality of *kathrat al-tarouqah* (frequent mating) as a sign of vitality and abundance in creation. The narration serves to illustrate how observable natural phenomena can reflect higher theological truths, a common hermeneutical approach in Shia hadith literature.
